modelFields.coverageLabel: Published complete requirement ledger with proposed approved-course choices; transfer placements require separate evidence.
rulesNotes: Foundation courses may fulfill select general education requirements; this baseline deliberately uses distinct approved general education courses and does not double count the nine foundational credits.
The source permits RLGN 104 waiver after 45 qualifying transfer credits and THEO 104 waiver after 60. Neither waiver is applied automatically.

The baseline selects the printed three-credit UNIV 104 case and 12 published free-elective credits. A confirmed zero-credit UNIV case can replace those three credits with additional electives within the printed range.
An internship of up to six hours is strongly recommended, not stated as a separate mandatory graduation requirement.
All applicable prerequisites must be met.

unresolved.message: Submit official records for Liberty’s individual transfer award, admission/catalog rights, state-specific general-education additions and duplicate-learning check.

This baseline retains all 120 published degree credits, the three-credit UNIV 104 case, the listed religion requirements and the full 66-credit major ledger. It applies no transfer waiver or foundational overlap. The four distinct three-credit art/history awards fill the unrestricted 12-credit elective component without repeating a fixed degree course.
Additional outside options may improve this route. Named university fallback courses do not establish that outside credit is prohibited.
Before registration, record accepted prerequisite credit or the published assessment results and select available sections. No assessment pass or future section availability is assumed.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 evaluation
obligations.notes: The source prints 0–3 credits. This ledger retains 3; only a university-confirmed zero-credit case releases 3 credits for additional electives.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.description: Submit the degree completion application within the final semester of anticipated graduation.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: The source’s 22 three-credit Major Requirements and Foundational Courses rows total 66 credits, allocated once. The baseline retains more than 25% of that component at Liberty.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

cliMappingReview.scope: Exact fixed receiving awards; undergraduate degree/format and eligible transcript-route conditions remain explicit.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate policy does not publish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. This route retains the 90-credit overall transfer ceiling and 30-credit Liberty minimum; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or individual award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
